candidates.name: TTY
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: OmarchyPet desktop companion design exploration ROUND 02. Produce one square concept sheet for ONE original character in authentic hard-edged low-resolution PIXEL ART. Pixel sprite construction is crucial: a strict coarse square grid, crisp nearest-neighbor edges, flat clusters of pixels, NO smooth illustration, NO anti-aliased vector edges, NO 3D rendering, NO brushwork. Think highly readable handcrafted 40x40 to 64x64 game sprite magnified. Background flat charcoal #282828. Restricted palette: near-black #161616, mid gray #707070, off-white #E4E4E4, white #F5F5F5 and restrained ice blue #ADD8F0. One large full-body hero sprite centered in upper 70%, three little poses of this same character along bottom (resting, attentive, celebrating). Keep all silhouette extremities inside canvas. Top left a small pixel-font heading exactly as specified, no other text. Large negative space, simple memorable silhouette, lively but restrained expression. No desktop UI, frames, landscape, props unrelated to character, watermarks. User likes pixel style but has NOT chosen animal direction. Avoid realistic mechanical crab/robot styling, moths, wings, spindly limbs, feather/ink texture. Four candidates are intentionally radically different; do not converge to a generic round blob with two eyes.
Heading "05 / TTY". Character: a living compact rectangular terminal tile, flat frontal square charcoal face with thick pale-gray stair-step border and two short chunky rectangular pale feet. Face has ONE ice-blue command prompt glyph '>' on left and a pale blinking underscore on right; these are its expressive face, no conventional eyes or mouth. Upper-right corner folds inward with a missing square notch, giving an asymmetric recognizable outline. Two tiny blocky side arms can extend as plain rectangles. Upright geometric compact silhouette, digital no-nonsense little helper with personality in its tilt and prompt. Pure 2D sprite, absolutely no screen depth, mechanical parts, shading gradients, antennas or robot head. Keep face glyphs large and readable. Poses change tile lean, arm angle and underscore position.
